canonicalRequirements.statement: GATE15 is COMPLETE_CONFIRMED under its canonical lifecycle before GATE16 execution.
A separate GATE16 execution contract and exact authority scope exist.
The producer and independent verifier identities are distinct and resolvable.
No invalidation basis is asserted for already valid closed Gates.
Every mandatory closure claim has an admissible independent verifier.
The verifier recalculates the verdict from canonical inputs without treating the producer verdict as authority.
All evidence and hashes bind to the declared source bytes.
Circular validation and unsupported closure claims are rejected.
Independent replay produces identical verdicts and evidence digests.
No unrelated regression identity is introduced.

requiredOutputs.role: Positive, negative, counter and hostile tests
Recalculated crosscheck report with evidence bindings

positiveTests.case: distinct producer and independent verifier identities with admissible authority
verdict recalculated from canonical inputs without consuming producer PASS as authority
source and evidence bytes reproduce every declared hash
fresh-process replay returns identical verdict and evidence digest

negativeTests.mutation: use the producer as the independent verifier
replace recalculation with the producer PASS field
change a bound source byte without changing its hash
remove an evidence edge or assert an unsupported closure
alter replay inputs between independent processes

countertests.mutation: make producer and verifier identities equal
hardcode PASS while changing canonical input
remove or redirect a source edge

reuseRules: Reuse only fast-path R4 evidence whose exact source bytes and identities remain unchanged.
Producer PASS, generated projections and summaries never bootstrap independent authority.
The sealed GATE15 COMPLETE_CONFIRMED state is reusable while its ledger-bound cohort remains byte-identical.
invalidationRules: Any change to the registry, mandate, dependency state, ledger or validator bytes invalidates the affected identity.
Unknown, stale, contradictory or unverified evidence is non-reusable and blocks closed claims.
Any producer-auditor identity collision, source-hash mismatch or replay drift invalidates the crosscheck.
forbiddenReplays: Re-executing valid closed Gates without an admissible invalidation basis.
Using a producer summary, self-attested PASS or generated projection as independent authority.
Any network call, broker write, Git push, history rewrite, ACTIVE_GATE switch or GEE R8 creation.
Hardcoded PASS, fabricated evidence, future leakage, parallel authority or circular validation.
Implementation or closure of GATE17 or any later Gate in this mission.
packagingRequirements: Stable UTF-8 JSON and exact slash-separated repository-relative paths.
All identities use recomputed SHA-256 over the actual bytes.
Generated views are projections and never canonical authority.
closureConditions: Every mandatory closure claim has an admissible independent verifier.
The verifier recalculates the verdict from canonical inputs and does not consume the producer verdict as authority.
All evidence and hashes bind to the declared source bytes.
Circular validation and unsupported closure claims are rejected.
Independent replay produces identical verdicts and evidence digests.
No unrelated regression identity is introduced.
nextGateAuthorizationConditions: GATE16 must reach COMPLETE_CONFIRMED through its own independent-crosscheck lifecycle before GATE17 can be considered.
GATE17 requires a separate execution contract and exact authority scope.
GATE16 PASS does not authorize GATE17 execution or any later Gate.

sourceReferences.evidence: Canonical GATE16 mandate, entry conditions, outputs and closure conditions.
Canonical GATE16 identity, objective and dependency projection.
Closed predecessor state consumed without re-execution.
Fail-closed governance and Git containment rules.
Canonical GEE fast-path and recovery machinery.
